#### 1. Leber congenital amaurosis 15  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.784)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:12423)

**Proposed mechanism:** TULP1 (HGNC:12423) —DISRUPTS→ Retinal photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance (GO:0002024); Retinal photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance (GO:0002024) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal degeneration (HP:0011010); Retinal photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance (GO:0002024) —LEADS_TO→ Reduced visual acuity (HP:0007759); Retinal photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance (GO:0002024) —LEADS_TO→ Impaired pupillary light reflex (HP:0000512); Retinal photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance (GO:0002024) —LEADS_TO→ Nystagmus (HP:0000639). **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of TULP1 in these distinct retinal disorders offers potential for therapeutic strategies targeting the common downstream pathway of photoreceptor maintenance, which could benefit patients with either condition.
